name: Togoshi-Koen
tagline: Shinagawa in 14 minutes and Shibuya in 25 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 30 minutes to Shinjuku, 25 minutes to Shibuya and 14 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 22.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 22.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 17.9 m to 23.9 m, a difference of 6.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 8 clinics and 8 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 昭和医科大学病院附属東病院, about 19 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 昭和医科大学病院, about 22 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Oimachi Line.
congestion: Tokyu Oimachi Line runs at 118% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 九品仏→自由が丘, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth and schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Ebara-Nakanobu is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Togoshi-Koen is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Togoshi-Koen. Ebara-Nakanobu has the Tokyu Ikegami Line, a different set from Togoshi-Koen. To Shinagawa, for instance, Ebara-Nakanobu takes 8 minutes longer. On the number of places to eat out, Ebara-Nakanobu comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Nakanobu is ahead on the number of lines and the number of medical facilities, but Togoshi-Koen is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Togoshi-Koen. Nakanobu also has the Toei Asakusa Line, which Togoshi-Koen does not. With more lines, Nakanobu is the better connected of the two. To Roppongi, for instance, Nakanobu is 7 minutes quicker. On quiet, though, Togoshi-Koen comes out ahead.

People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: 鮫洲大山線 (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Oimachi Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
